footnotes: From pre-tax loss to net loss to NIO: after CN¥628M attributable to noncontrolling interests.

Figures are from the company's Form 20-F for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue rose 33.1% to CN¥87.5B in 2025. Gross margin was 13.6%, versus 9.9% a year earlier, and the operating loss narrowed to CN¥14.0B from CN¥21.9B.
The net loss narrowed to CN¥15.6B, or −CN¥6.85 per share, from CN¥22.7B. Operating cash flow was CN¥3.0B and free cash flow −CN¥3.1B, versus −CN¥17.0B.
watch: Cash ended the year at CN¥31.0B.
sources: NIO Inc. Form 20-F for FY2025 (SEC EDGAR)
